dataset: Current Population Survey Annual Social and Economic Supplement (cps/asec/mar)
notes: CPS ASEC is a sample of person records; weighted cells estimate population counts. The API serves no replicate weights, so sampling error is not computed here.
Household income (HTOTVAL) divided by the square root of household size, in $2,500 bins labelled by lower edge; at or above $150,000 one bin, below $0 one bin labelled -2,500.
Children are persons under 18; race is Hispanic of any race, else White, Black, Asian alone, else other non-Hispanic; age group is the household reference person's.
Aggregated to 1242 cell(s) from 144265 person record(s); 444 cell(s) with fewer than 10 records were withheld (1909 record(s), weighted 4,531,099). No person-level row is returned.
